author: reek
body: Reference designator assignment and renumbering for schematic symbols. Given a list of placed symbols with positions, assigns sequential reference numbers per prefix (R, C, U, etc) sorted by the chosen annotation mode. Supports per-sheet, left-to-right, top-to-bottom, and positional ordering.

author: reek
body: An entry represents one symbol to be annotated. The ref-prefix is the letter portion of the reference designator (R, C, U). The current-number is the existing numeric suffix, or 0 if unassigned.

author: reek
body: Extract the prefix and number from a reference designator by checking known prefixes. Supports two-letter prefixes (SW, FB, TP) and single-letter prefixes (R, C, U, L, D, Q, J, K, Y, X, F, P).

author: reek
body: Insertion sort for annotation entries. The comparison function is determined by the annotation mode.

author: reek
body: Walk sorted entries, assigning the next available number for each prefix. Tracks the running next-number per prefix and accumulates assignments.

author: reek
body: Renumber all entries starting from a given base number, ignoring prefix grouping. Each entry gets base + its position in the sorted list.
